summary: Megri Soft Limited stated that related party transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) are not applicable for the half-year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Laxmi Dental approves Leelaben Foundation membership
summary: Laxmi Dental Ltd board approved joining Leelaben Foundation, a Section 8 non-profit. The company will contribute up to ₹1,000 as guarantee. Board also noted a fine for delayed compliance.

headline: BSE approves trading for IIRM Holdings preferential shares
summary: IIRM Holdings India Ltd received BSE trading approval for 15.59 lakh equity shares allotted on a preferential basis to non-promoters, effective October 9, 2026.

headline: IRB InvIT toll revenue up 6% YoY in Sep 2026
summary: IRB InvIT Fund reported gross toll revenue of ₹1,401 million for September 2026, marking a 6% year-on-year increase. Growth was driven by key assets like Tumkur Chitradurga and Hapur Moradabad.

headline: Jupiter Life Line to host Q2FY27 earnings call
summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals will discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance on October 26, 2026. Investors can pre-register for the conference call.

headline: BLS E-Services completes 1:2 share split
summary: BLS E-Services Limited confirmed the credit of sub-divided shares under a new ISIN following a 1:2 split. The company's paid-up capital remains unchanged at ₹90.85 crore.

headline: Asia Capital CS withdraws resignation
summary: Prateek Sharma has withdrawn his resignation as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of Asia Capital Limited, continuing in his role without any break in services.

headline: Highway Infrastructure wins ₹24.46 crore toll deal
summary: Highway Infrastructure signed a toll plaza operations deal worth ₹24.46 crore at Velanchettiyur Fee Plaza, marking a new contract win for the company.

headline: Centuple Global board meets Oct 12 for auditor, director changes
summary: Centuple Global Ltd will hold a board meeting on October 12, 2026, to appoint a statutory auditor and change Ajay Kumar Agarwal's designation. Trading window is closed.

headline: Kratikal Tech sets up US subsidiary
summary: Kratikal Tech Limited incorporated Kratikal AI Inc. in Delaware, USA, as a wholly owned subsidiary for cybersecurity services. The entity has a paid-up capital of $10,000.

headline: Stock exchanges reject Chalet Hotels reclassification
summary: Stock exchanges rejected Chalet Hotels' application to reclassify four entities from Promoter Group to Public under Reg 31A, citing Mindspace REIT sponsorship links.

headline: IRB Infrastructure toll revenue up 24% YoY in Sept
summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers reported gross toll revenue of ₹773 crore for September 2026, marking a 24% year-on-year increase driven by festive traffic and new asset contributions.

headline: NCLT orders GOCL to convene merger meetings
summary: GOCL Corporation received an NCLT order to hold shareholder and creditor meetings for its merger with Hinduja National Power Corporation.

headline: Sammaan Capital pays interest on NCDs ahead of due date
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited certified timely payment of interest on seven series of Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures. The company settled dues on October 8, 2026, one day prior to the scheduled due date.

headline: Mangalam Worldwide submits postal ballot proceedings
summary: Mangalam Worldwide Limited submitted postal ballot proceedings regarding director appointments and remuneration. Voting concluded on October 8, 2026.

headline: Onix Solar Q2FY27: Profit jumps to ₹191.54 lakh
summary: Onix Solar Energy Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹191.54 lakh for Q2FY27, up from a loss in the year-ago quarter. Revenue stood at ₹3,187.60 lakh.

headline: TCS flags margin pressure in second half
summary: Tata Consultancy Services forecasts margin challenges in the second half, citing seasonal factors and dilution from acquisitions as key headwinds.

headline: LIC re-designates Sonija M.S. as Chief Finance
summary: LIC re-designates Sonija M.S. as Chief (I/C) Finance & Accounts, qualifying her as Senior Management Personnel effective October 8, 2026.

headline: K&R Rail Q1FY27 Results: Loss widens, going concern doubt
summary: K&R Rail Engineering reported a standalone net loss of ₹20.32 lakh for Q1FY27. Revenue collapsed to ₹1.69 crore, and auditors flagged material uncertainty regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern.

headline: Himadri wins Golden Peacock Sustainability Award 2026
summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd has won the Golden Peacock Award for Sustainability 2026 in the chemical sector, recognizing its commitment to green operations and responsible innovation.

headline: Bhagyanagar board reshuffle and cost apportionment
summary: Bhagyanagar India appoints Mangilal Surana as director, accepts Nukala's resignation, and finalizes 89.36% cost apportionment to Tieramet.

headline: Evervie Health pays ₹13.46 crore NCD interest in advance
summary: Evervie Health Limited, formerly PVP Ventures, paid ₹13.46 crore interest on Non-Convertible Debentures ahead of schedule for Dec 2026 and Mar 2027.

headline: Virat Industries appoints AI advisor, explores tech verticals
summary: Brahm Virat Industries appointed Ranju Das as external AI advisor and approved strategic exploration of AI verticals. The board also noted CFO Bhavik Maisuria's resignation effective December 31, 2026.

headline: Mangalam Cement faces ₹2.70 Cr GST penalty
summary: Mangalam Cement received a GST order for ₹2.70 crore regarding wrong ITC availing. The company plans to appeal the decision under the CGST Act.

headline: P.M. Telelinnks appoints Sonia Tandon as CS
summary: P.M. Telelinnks Limited appointed Sonia Tandon as Company Secretary, Compliance Officer, and KMP effective October 8, 2026. She is an ICSI member with expertise in corporate governance.

headline: Shree Rajeshwaranand approves revised preferential issue
summary: Shree Rajeshwaranand Paper Mills approves revised allottee list for 1.2 crore equity shares. The issue constitutes 94.81% of post-allotment capital, superseding prior board decisions.

headline: Wallfort Financial fined ₹1.8 lakh by NSE
summary: Wallfort Financial Services Ltd received a penalty of ₹1,80,000 from NSE for trade handling violations in May 2026. The company stated the impact on operations is nil.

headline: TCS exec: Data center earnings in 18-24 months
summary: Tata Consultancy Services executive states data center earnings will begin flowing in 18-24 months. AI adoption progress highlighted in banking, manufacturing, and life sciences sectors.

headline: Dalmia Bharat Sugar pays ₹1.55 lakh GST penalty
summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar & Industries Ltd received a penalty of ₹1,55,301 from UP-GST for e-way bill violations. The company states there is no material impact on operations.

headline: Raymond Realty invests ₹90,000 in subsidiary
summary: Raymond Realty Limited invested ₹90,000 in wholly owned subsidiary Ten X Realty North Limited via rights issue. The subsidiary, incorporated in Oct 2025, reported nil turnover for FY26.

headline: Bacil Pharma CS resigns effective Oct 8
summary: Bacil Pharma Ltd announced the resignation of Whole-Time Company Secretary Dikshant Singh Panwar, effective October 8, 2026. The company is initiating steps to appoint a successor.

headline: Tiaan Consumer posts ₹82,800 lakh revenue in Q2FY27
summary: Tiaan Consumer Limited reported total income from operations of ₹82,800.00 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, against ₹5.22 lakhs in the corresponding quarter.

headline: Sollfege Smart confirms Kfin as RTA
summary: Sollfege Smart Electronics Limited confirmed Kfin Technologies Limited continues as its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent under SEBI Regulation 7(1).

headline: IFGL Refractories passes CEO appointment resolution
summary: IFGL Refractories shareholders approved Mukesh Harshadrai Rawal as Whole-time Director and CEO India via postal ballot with 99.99% votes in favor.

headline: Madhav Infra to consider preferential issue on Oct 13
summary: Madhav Infra Projects Ltd board will meet Oct 13, 2026, to approve converting promoter loans into equity via a preferential issue and changing preference share terms.

headline: Sollfege discloses fair disclosure code
summary: Sollfege Smart Electronics filed intimation under SEBI PIT Regulations 2015, making its Code of Practices for Fair Disclosure of UPSI available on its website.

headline: Lotus Chocolate Q2FY27: Loss widens to ₹380 lakh
summary: Lotus Chocolate Company Limited reported a net loss of ₹380.43 lakh for Q2FY27, a sharp reversal from the ₹144.32 lakh profit in Q2FY26. Revenue from operations fell 43% YoY to ₹9,143.41 lakh.

headline: Vruddhi Engineering FY26 PAT up 106% to ₹308 lakh
summary: Vruddhi Engineering Works Ltd reported a 106% YoY jump in annual net profit for FY26. Revenue rose 35% to ₹4,300 lakh, driven by strong operational cash flow.

headline: TCS hires 10,000 fresh graduates in Q2
summary: Tata Consultancy Services reported hiring 10,000 fresh graduates in Q2, signalling continued campus recruitment activity at one of India's largest IT employers.

headline: US suspends immigration program for top Indian IT firms
summary: The US has suspended an immigration program affecting Cognizant, Infosys, and Tata Consultancy Services, impacting workforce mobility for major Indian IT companies.

headline: Meghmani Organics gets NCLT nod for subsidiary merger
summary: NCLT Ahmedabad sanctioned the amalgamation of two wholly owned subsidiaries with Meghmani Organics. The scheme is effective from January 1, 2026, aiming to simplify group structure.

headline: Seshachal Tech board approves ₹10 crore investment in Triveni Jewellers
summary: Seshachal Technologies board approved a ₹10 crore investment in Triveni Jewellers and Bullion Private Limited. The EGM mode shifted to virtual, with special resolution required for the cross-sector investment.

headline: Comrade Appliances board to meet Oct 13
summary: Comrade Appliances Ltd scheduled a board meeting for October 13, 2026, to consider preferential or rights issues. Trading window remains closed until results.

headline: CIE Automotive India initiates merger notice dispatch
summary: CIE Automotive India has begun dispatching notices to shareholders and creditors for its merger with wholly owned subsidiary CIE Aluminium Casting India, following NCLT approval.

headline: Lupin gets US FDA nod for Phytonadione injectable
summary: Lupin received US FDA approval for Phytonadione Injectable Emulsion 1 MG/0.5 ML Pre-filled Syringe, marking a regulatory clearance for its injectable product portfolio in the US market.

headline: Tilaknagar CFO resigns; Singal takes charge
summary: Tilaknagar Industries CFO Rajesh Choudhary resigned on October 8, 2026. Deputy CFO Anil Singal has been appointed as Senior Management Personnel to oversee finance.

headline: Jaykay Enterprises signs ₹100 crore loan deal with JK Defence
summary: Jaykay Enterprises has signed a ₹100 crore loan agreement with its subsidiary JK Defence & Aerospace at a fixed interest rate of 10% annually, with disbursement to occur in parts.

headline: Lemon Tree subsidiary gets CGST demand set aside
summary: Lemon Tree Hotels subsidiary Sukhsagar Complexes had ₹82,554 CGST demand and penalty set aside by Commissioner (Appeals) on Oct 8, 2026. No financial impact.

headline: Krsnaa Diagnostics gets in-principle approval for warrant issue
summary: Krsnaa Diagnostics received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE to issue 16,21,000 convertible warrants to its promoter group at ₹566 per share on a preferential basis.

headline: Crazy Snacks FY26 results: Profit up 6.4%
summary: Crazy Snacks Ltd reports consolidated PAT of ₹650.60 lakh for FY26, a 6.4% YoY rise. Revenue grew 4.4% to ₹11,628.85 lakh, driven by steady demand in bakery and snack segments.
